summary: Backend: all 18 pytest tests PASS (health, contact, appointment, quote/all tiers, auth register/login/me, client projects, blog list/detail/404, AI SSE stream). Frontend: hero, navbar scroll & menu, contact form submit, appointment booking modal, AI streaming assistant, /login register + /client dashboard + logout, /portfolio filters visible, /blog list + detail — all PASS. One clear bug: Cost Calculator (CALC) submit fails with HTTP 422 because the frontend sends name/email/phone as empty strings and backend Pydantic EmailStr rejects empty string for the Optional email field.

minor.issue: Rejects empty string for optional 'email' field (Pydantic EmailStr) — returns 422 when frontend sends email:''. Backend should treat '' as None, OR frontend must omit empty fields.

ui_bugs.issue: Submitting the Cost Calculator (default: Villa/3000/luxury/Srinagar) triggers axios 422 from /api/quote because {name:'', email:'', phone:''} is sent. calc-result never appears. Runtime error overlay is shown by CRA.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend sends empty strings for optional user fields; backend validates email as EmailStr and returns 422. Fix by stripping empty optional fields on the client (e.g., only include name/email/phone if non-empty) or by relaxing backend (accept '' as None).

issues: Sticky FABs (WhatsApp, Appointment, Calculator, AI) overlap Footer content in the bottom-right corner on desktop — consider hiding when footer intersects viewport.

action_items: Fix CostCalculator submit: in /app/frontend/src/components/CostCalculator.jsx submit(), build a payload that omits name/email/phone when they are empty strings (or send undefined). Alternatively, on backend accept empty string as None for the Optional[EmailStr] email field on QuoteCreate.
Consider auto-hiding floating action buttons over the footer to avoid visual overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: startup uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan handler.
server.py: Quote model accepts Optional[EmailStr] but frontend consistently posts empty string; either coerce '' → None with a validator or make it plain Optional[str] with a manual email regex.
AIAssistant: message elements share data-testid='ai-message' with no data-role attribute — adding data-role='user'/'assistant' would greatly improve test-ability.
CostCalculator: no error state UI — if /api/quote fails, the modal silently stays open and only CRA overlay hints at failure. Add toast/error text for the user.
Contact.jsx: uses native <select> with option strings — accepted but styled poorly against dark theme; consider shadcn Select for consistency.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (Cost Calculator failing; all other flows pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). All backend passes. Only Cost Calculator UI flow needs retest after fix (either coerce empty→None on QuoteCreate.email in server.py OR sanitize payload in CostCalculator.jsx submit()). Note that CRA runtime error overlay from an unhandled axios rejection can obscure subsequent tests — dismiss or reload the page between tests. AI stream messages use data-testid='ai-message' with role encoded only via internal styling; use the last message element as the assistant response.
rca of the issue: Cost Calculator posts {name:'', email:'', phone:''} because CostCalculator.jsx spreads its state as-is. Backend QuoteCreate.email is Optional[EmailStr]; Pydantic v2 EmailStr rejects '' → returns 422 with 'value is not a valid email address'. Reproduction: curl -X POST /api/quote -d '{"project_type":"Villa","area_sqft":3000,"quality_tier":"luxury","location":"Srinagar","name":"","email":"","phone":""}' → 422. Mitigation: strip empty strings client-side, or add a Pydantic field_validator on QuoteCreate.email to convert '' to None.
